== Biography ==
John was born in 1656. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3078|Archibald Glasgow]] and [[Watson-45727|Agnes Watson]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3078]] is assessed at 85% (probable). Johne's 27 April 1656 Leith South index names Archbald Glasgow and Agnes Watsone. The full Archibald/Agnes Watson couple, South Leith locality and 1654–56 sequence identify a coherent adult household compatible with Archibald’s 1618 generation.

Probable identification with Archibald-3078’s childhood account; the record father role is explicit and mother is assessed independently.

Next useful test: Use the marriage and occupational records to connect the adult to the 1618 family.
